text: Third time trying to get through. I'm a childminder, I've got a 1 month old boy here till his parents get back and his temperature is 39.4. Took it twice to be sure. He's wide awake and alert, watching me, and he woke up easily when I picked him up so he's not sleepy or anything. I've texted the parents but they haven't answered. I need someone to tell me what to do please.
